games.name: Bazaar Below Zero
games.description: Don Morsa has kidnapped you. Time to get to work! Mine ice, uncover frozen items and sell them to seals in this incremental co-op game for 1–4 players. Organize your bazaar, upgrade your tools and hire penguins. Explore the glacier’s secrets as you plot your escape.

games.name: Sunbed Simulator
games.description: Take over an unlicensed beach with a few sunbeds and become king of the coast! In this first-person business sim, serve guests, hire staff and grow your resort – solo or in online co-op with friends. Bribe the police and sabotage the hotel next door. On this beach, you make the rules!

games.name: Bricked
games.description: Bricked is a city-building sandbox set on a tabletop above the clouds. Build a toy-brick city piece by piece, set kaiju, mechs and armies against each other, and watch every strike tear it apart. Put every brick back with one click, then fly, drive and ride through the city you made.

games.name: Greed, the dice game
games.description: One more roll could change everything. Play with up to three friends or take on bots in a dice game of risky choices, devilish bargains, and playful table mischief. Bank your points, push your luck, and make the table your own.

games.name: GermShake
games.description: A pixel-art roguelike where you play a germ spreading through Shake City one handshake at a time. Mutate, dodge the immune system, and survive the sink.

games.name: Jingle Janitor
games.description: Your first night as Santa's janitor, and the elves partied all night. Sort a gloriously messy workshop until every toy part sits on its shelf, learn handy magic, cheer up the elves and save Christmas. Cozy first-person tidying, alone or with a friend on the couch.

games.name: Tiny Crimes
games.description: Who needs money when you can sneak your way into anywhere? Team up with your fellow rats, explore different stores, grab all the supplies, and fulfill your community’s peculiar requests… But watch out! Things can get out of paw pretty quickly.

games.name: Rekisen TCG
games.description: With its signature "Rekisen Summoning" system, this snappy arcade card game offers a unique experience with 80 carefully balanced cards. Play your favorite modes, earn gold, and open booster packs to collect cards and build custom decks.

games.name: Multi Purpose Wheel Incremental
games.description: Rotate everything in this new spin on the Incremental genre! Rotate satisfying contraptions to earn interconnected currencies. Upgrade the contraptions to earn more, earn faster, and earn whackier. Unlock new contraptions to expand your rotating horizons.

games.name: POKUS
games.description: Sling spells and shatter friendships in a chaotic wizard tavern. In this online card battler for 2-6 player, play as petty mages whose hexes hilariously backfire. Break fragile alliances and haunt your friends from the grave in frantic 15-minute bouts of magical mayhem.

games.name: Default Zombie Shooter
games.description: You and your team woke up in a ruined city. Hordes of zombies roam the streets. There will be no answers. Grab a gun and shoot!

games.name: Kixball
games.description: Kixball is top-down physics football where you are one player on the pitch. No animations, no auto-aim: just you, the ball and the walls. Train, earn transfer offers and rise from the lowest division in your career, or play with up to 3 friends on one screen.

games.name: Bibliopyre
games.description: A magical storm and a goblin horde tore a million forbidden pages from the Great Library. As the Warden Mage, burn them all: sweep piles with waves of fire, send ash flying home, and hear every book chime into place to the beat of the music.

games.name: BONK! The Mole Show
games.description: Whack-a-Mole, but one BONK can set off the whole machine. Move the hammer, pick the column and watch Tesla moles zap, bombs blast and golden chains roar. Build a wild combo engine in a pixel-art fairground roguelite.

games.name: Before We Sink
games.description: Your island is sinking and the sea rises every minute. Gather wood, patch a wrecked boat and escape before the water swallows everything. Explore cursed islands, fight pirates and skeletons, and sail a galleon through storms, alone or in co-op for up to 5 players.

games.name: MUTINY!
games.description: MUTINY! is a multiplayer platformer fighter game that allows up to 10 players per round! Using different kinds of bombs and the power of physics, ensure your victory as the last man standing on pirate ships, treacherous waters, and other dynamic maps that aren't exactly on your side either.

games.name: Cornerwitch
games.description: Cornerwitch is a cozy idler game that sits on the corner of your screen. Study new spells and advance through a magical journey. Unlock cosmetics to dress up your little witch, level up and become stronger.

games.name: DYNASTY: Silk & Blood
games.description: 1980. You have $5 million and a family name. Build companies, conquer markets, marry, raise your heirs. Rival dynasties never rest and the world never waits. You will die. Your dynasty must not.

games.name: Fleshwounds & Feathers
games.description: Enter a world of bird wielding knights! Fight your friends in this online, PvP, free for all, deathmatch, arena shooter. Explore the map, find new goofy weapons to help defeat your friends. You set the playtime and score to beat. Enjoy all this along with game adaptive medieval drum and bass!

games.name: Car Wash Crew
games.description: Run a roadside car wash solo or with up to 3 friends. Blast mud, spread foam and build new bays by hand. Customers bring cars, buses, rugs—and the occasional house. Follow their tickets, split the work and try to keep your crew out of the soap.

games.name: Cartastrophe
games.description: CARTASTROPHE is a party game for 1–4 players, streamed live as the internet's most exciting death game. Crash, shoot and stab your way through minigames for likes, and survive the Final Showdown to walk out famous.

games.name: Magnet Fishing Together
games.description: A cozy co-op game about magnet fishing with up to 4 friends. Throw, pull and hope for something good. Sometimes it’s a rusty spoon. Sometimes it’s a scooter you can ride. And sometimes your friend lets go of the rope at the worst possible moment.

games.name: Sort the Bazaar
games.description: Sort The Bazaar is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort a variety of items and bring life and color back to a faded roadside market. Unlock new skills, automate tasks, and enjoy the satisfying process of turning a dull, messy bazaar into a vibrant, organized marketplace at your own pace.

games.name: One More Asteroid
games.description: Drill voxel asteroids apart in an incremental mining game. Grow from one drill to a swarm of drones that mine where you aim. Unlock powerful tools, crack the core and watch the asteroid collapse. Then take on the next, stranger rock.

games.name: Social Net
games.description: Incremental fishing in reverse: a fish catches people with money. Throw your net into the crowd, yank sunbathers out with the rod, hand in the catch, unlock the skill tree and new places - from a sunny beach to an icy bay and an ocean liner.

games.name: GUTTERGLOW
games.description: A bowling roguelike with real pin physics. Aim and throw, score points for every pin that falls, and build your ball with pins, tricks and upgrades until one throw multiplies into a huge score. Ten levels, twelve bosses that change the lane, three modes.

games.name: Quiet Bloom
games.description: Quiet Bloom is a cozy idle game. Awaken the wind, dig wells, and call the rain to tend your land for you. Gather wood, stone, and water, raise wind vanes and solar panels, and watch a cracked desert slowly bloom into a luxuriant green oasis.

games.name: Loss Prevention: Prologue
games.description: Loss Prevention is a social deduction game where you can shoplift your local grocery store with up to five friends. Experience the joy of petty crime as a shoplifter, or keep your eyes peeled for suspicious activity as the shopkeeper. Can you grab all the items on the shopping list?

games.name: Idle Tides
games.description: Idle Tides is an idle incremental where your goal is simple: Catch as many fish as you can. Unlock new boats to automate your fishing, upgrade your fleet, and help the island with this fish overpopulation!

games.name: Orca Girl: Idle Fishing Story
games.description: Enjoy idle fishing with your orca girl companion. Grow crops, craft bait, and collect rare and exotic fish. Decorate your own pixel aquarium and build a cozy desktop island. Play solo or enjoy relaxing fishing trips with friends in multiplayer for up to 8 players.

games.name: Island Keeper
games.description: Island Keeper is a cozy exploration and restoration adventure. As maintenance robot Ferrum-1, clean up a polluted archipelago, recycle rubbish into gear and stations, and watch every island turn green again as wildlife returns.

games.name: Cucumber
games.description: One cucumber. One space bar. Suddenly, a collection. Make your cucumber jump, collect designs through activity in the game, combine cucumbers through crafting and display your favourites. A free meme game with optional cosmetic shop items.

games.name: Tinsel Tumble
games.description: A cozy Holiday falling-block puzzle game. Drop pairs of elves and presents into the well, land an elf beside presents of its color to wrap the lot, and set off chain reactions. Story, Endless, 50 Challenges, Daily, an Advent calendar, and couch Versus and Battle mode for up to 4 players.

games.name: Gnomes Garden: Fairy Kingdom
games.description: The Gnome Queen uncovers the history of the fairies, restores friendship, and fights an ancient darkness.

games.name: Idle Raiders: Second Run
games.description: Idle Raiders: Second Run is an idle RPG about a band of pixel art heroes who farm, raid and loot on their own. You build their town, pick their gear, skills and AI, and send them out farming or into more than 25 raids. Version 2.0 of the browser classic from Pit Forest, rebuilt on a new engine.

games.name: I just wanted a marshmallow.
games.description: 'I just wanted a marshmallow.' is a casual completely normal take on the arena shooter genre. Falling into the pits of despair over not having a marshmallow, you and your crew opt to take the matters into their own hands. There's not much else to say about this game.

games.name: Best Dam Game
games.description: Chew trees, throw logs, blow stuff up. Best Dam Game is co-op physics chaos for up to 4 beavers building one seriously big dam. Take the contract, beat the rising river, fire your friends out of a cannon, and hunt down some very important hats.

games.name: Toy or Not
games.description: Toy or Not ? is an online hide-and-seek party game for up to 8 players. Sneak around as a toy, collect batteries, and rescue your teammates—or play as a kid, spot suspicious toys, and send them back to the toy box. Turn an ordinary room into a playground of sneaky tricks and surprises!

games.name: Desktop Fantasy Packs: Idle Auto Battler
games.description: An idle auto-battler that lives in a small window on your desktop. Spend the gold your party earns on fantasy packs, collect hero, monster and even boss cards, and field a party of four. They fight on their own while you work. Sweep your mouse across the field to leave a trail of fire.

games.name: TrapRush
games.description: TrapRush is an online party platformer for 2 to 12 players. Each round, everyone places one item on the same course: a bridge, a spring, or a saw hidden under it. Then you all race to the flag at once. Make it while your friends don't, and you score.

games.name: $1 Pizza Slice
games.description: Run a cozy New York pizza shop where every slice costs $1. Roll dough, prepare toppings, bake and cut pizzas, then serve hungry neighbors. Shop for ingredients, upgrade your kitchen, share leftovers, and chip away at your debt one slice at a time.

games.name: Explosive Express
games.description: Explosive Express is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics game where tiny workers transport unstable bombs through a giant world. Work together, load the van, survive the hazards, and get the bomb home before time runs out.

games.name: Friendgeist
games.description: An online co-op horror comedy for up to 5 players. You wake up trapped in a house haunted by the Friendgeist, a spirit that takes the shape of a friend to deceive and possess you. Find the way out. If one of you gets possessed, exorcise them before it's too late. Or escape, if they let you.

games.name: Anomalous Coffee Machine 3
games.description: You're a broke freelance artist who just found a reality-bending coffee machine in your apartment stairwell. Discover anomalous drinks, dominate social media, sell your anomalous creations online, and spread the weirdness.

games.name: Elf Raid!
games.description: Storm the castle with a band of brave little elves and rescue Fairycorn before Sir Grumblebottom marries her! Couch co-op for 1 to 3 kids aged 3 to 10: pick a boy or girl elf in your own colours, choose your own difficulty, and nobody gets left behind.

games.name: Monolith Zero - An Incremental Odyssey
games.description: A pixel art incremental game of mining and drones. "Captain, the mothership has lost control near an unknown structure. We're stuck. It's pulling iron-laden asteroids towards us… It seems to want to help us."

games.name: It's a Montage
games.description: A pixel-art training game with no opponents, where every level you gain shows on your character and the world around you. Once you outgrow the dojo, you train at a waterfall, on the open sea, on the moon, on a star and at the edge of a black hole.

games.name: Re-Ball
games.description: A first-person hyper-ball fighter. Hit the ball and it's yours: it flies in your colour and knocks out anyone it touches. Every hit makes it faster. One hit and you're out. Time a PERFECT swing, steal a parry, and send your friends back to the lobby.

games.name: Make It Burn
games.description: A first-person incremental game about throwing gems into a hole. Press the buzzer, push the gems into the fire and buy machines to burn more and more. Bring the gem count on the wall down to zero to open the next room.

games.name: Build to Survive
games.description: Build a car, launch it down a mountain road and let physics decide. No steering, no second chances: pick the body, engine, suspension and tyres, then watch your machine fly, crash and fall apart. Beat gold times in Challenges or race two cars side by side in Free Drive.

games.name: Nameless Fate
games.description: Follow a bamboo path into a shared temple. Sweep leaves, meditate, strike a wooden fish, or count prayer beads. Earn incense and wish slips through practice, then light a stick or write a wish by hand as other players pass through the courtyard.

games.name: Sun Smith
games.description: Help an ancient derelict repair itself. Harvest power, mine ore, fabricate components, clone colonists, and research technologies.

games.name: Guildlands
games.description: Forge, fight and trade, together. A multiplayer idle RPG that lives on your taskbar: your hero fights, mines and fishes while you work, and every piece of gear you forge shows on them. Free to play, in a shared world where players set every price.

games.name: Pawlifters!
games.description: A 2–6 player party heist game, local or online. Cute animal thieves hide in plain sight: grab the loot and blend into the crowd. Or become the guard and whack your friends with a baton — just don’t mix them up with the visitors!

games.name: Musicality
games.description: A cozy co-op music toy. Plug synths, drums and pedals together in your own little home, record takes for the neighbours, and jam with friends over Steam.

games.name: Street Football: Foul Play
games.description: Play football with no rules, solo or with up to 4 friends in local or online co-op. Customize the weather and disasters, unleash brutal tackles and super shots on your rivals, and turn every match into total chaos!

games.name: Inside the Samosbor
games.description: A first-person co-op horror game for 1–4 players set in the world of Samosbor. Explore contaminated residential blocks, find a way out, and evade monsters and anomalies. Beware of liquidators who may mistake you for the infected. Get out alive.

games.name: Corner Quest
games.description: An idle auto-battler in the corner of your screen. Your Mage fights on her own while you work. Choose her Spells, reshape them with Forms and Runes, and fight through 50+ waves in 15 Biomes.

games.name: One More Potato
games.description: One More Potato is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 2,000 potatoes into their correct places across a countryside farm. Pick up potatoes, complete collections, unlock helpful upgrades, and turn a messy farm into a perfectly organized potato paradise, solo or with friends.

games.name: Carrot Planet
games.description: Cozy co-op incremental automation life sim for 1-8 players. Harvest an entire planet of carrots to feed the Bunny Mothership. Pick carrots, drive vehicles, automate everything, and befriend the locals. Build a massive carrot empire together!
